subject: Re: Kickoff: compositional-generalization recipe card
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Carmen Reyes leads at 50%, Fumiko Rossi 40% on the harness port (the release assumes Colab notebooks; we're making it batchable), Katya Silva 25% on dataset staging for SCAN/PCFG/COGS/CFQ, Nikhil Abebe 20% on eval plumbing.

For the extended phase: Wei Ivanov is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 to run the full repetition matrix — the paper-style num_repetitions sweeps across all dataset/model combinations that give us error bars worth publishing internally. He's lighter (20%) through the main sweep.

Compute: the individual runs are small but the grid is wide — several days end-to-end per the release docs. Asking for 40 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort April-May, similar in July for Wei's matrix.

Daniela
